note: Articles publish in order, one per weekly run (Tue 16:00 UTC). The publisher takes queue[0], wires it in, then removes it. Refill this list to keep weeks of hands-off publishing ready. Each article HTML lives in _queue/ and uses {{DATE}} and {{MONTH_YEAR}} placeholders filled with the real publish date.

queue.title: Managing People Who Out-Use You
queue.description: When a junior teammate is better with AI tools than their manager, the old logic of management gets awkward. Here is what I have learned about staying useful without pretending to keep up.

queue.title: The Paid Work Trial
queue.description: Unpaid take-home assignments quietly tax the people we say we want to hire. A short, paid work trial is a fairer test and a better one.

queue.title: Writing a Job Description Honestly
queue.description: Most job descriptions describe an imaginary person instead of a real problem. Here is what changed when I started writing postings that said what the work actually was.

queue.title: The Shelf Talker Nobody Reads
queue.description: Most of what a brand writes for the store goes unread. A look at what actually communicates a product to a shopper who gives it about two seconds.
